canonical_unknown_investment.scope: Conditional finite-reuse scenario. Supplied savings are assumptions, not demonstrated improvement; failed construction and maintenance remain costs. No investment is executed.

equations.repayment: Repayment requires B(N) >= 0 with equivalent accepted outcomes and complete attributable costs.
equations.constant_case_threshold: If s-m > 0, N_break_even = ceil(I_complete/(s-m)); otherwise positive I has no finite payoff under that assumption.
equations.acceptance_and_failures: Cost per accepted delivery includes every failed attempt and correction in the numerator.
equations.low_utilization: Recurring cost per accepted delivery = total recurring delivery and shared costs / accepted deliveries; zero accepted output has no finite per-accepted cost.
equations.financing: Available_to_commit = cash - unpaid_obligations - required_reserves; simulated savings or allocations are not collections.
